# MyST's LaTeX template renderings, vendored as an external corpus.
#
# source:   five LaTeX templates of the myst-templates organisation, each its repository's
#           default branch downloaded on 2026-10-20 (no git history), the commit each was
#           checked against on 2026-10-22 named in LICENSES.txt: every template file taken
#           here is byte-identical to raw.githubusercontent.com/myst-templates/<set>/<commit>.
# rendered: `myst build --tex` (mystmd 1.11.0) of paper.md, myst.yml and refs.bib, which
#           this repository wrote: invented content (a title, two invented authors at
#           example.org, an abstract, a citation, a footnote, a labelled equation, a table,
#           a note admonition, a list and a code block), each set's template given as a
#           local path; main.bbl is bibtex's or biber's output from main.bib.
# license:  each set's own, as its template.yml beside its rendering declares it, with the
#           attribution and change notices in LICENSES.txt. A set is taken where its
#           licence's terms can be met here and its bundled files are the template authors'
#           own or carry a licence of their own:
#
#   set                licence     bundled files
#   plain_latex        CC-BY-4.0   the template's own
#   plain_latex_book   CC-BY-4.0   the template's own
#   arxiv_two_column   CC-BY-4.0   preprint.sty, the template's own
#   curvenote          CC-BY-4.0   curvenote.sty, curvenote.def, the template's own
#   cageo              LPPL-1.2    cas-sc.cls, cas-dc.cls, cas-common.sty (LPPL 1.2+)
#
# Not taken, so measured only in local acceptance runs: arxiv_nips, lapreprint and
# physical_review_journals (MIT, whose copyright notice no upstream file states, and
# revtex4-2.cls's README restrictions), agu2019 (GPL-3.0), frontiers and volcanica (no
# licence declared), isprs, mdpi and spie_proceedings (a publisher's class whose header
# names no licence) and springer (sn-jnl.cls asks to travel with the LaTeX base system);
# egu_copernicus, physiome and eartharxiv fail mystmd 1.11's own template validation.
#
# checked:  every file taken is listed in SHA256SUMS with the sha256 of its bytes;
#           `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` run from this directory verifies them.
#
# lualatex (TeX Live 2026, latexmk -lualatex with bibtex or biber) built every document
# when it was imported, to these page counts; `--report` rebuilds them with lualatex
# alone over the vendored main.bbl:
#
#   plain_latex 2, plain_latex_book 4, arxiv_two_column 1, curvenote 2, cageo 4
